In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the polynomial curve fitting is the most suitable for SEIG.
the best curve fitting technique is the one that gives the best results for the particular application.
the polynomial approach is the best for the curve fitting of the magnetization characteristics of SEIG.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the curve fitting of the Vg - Im characteristics for SEIG is not a straight forward problem and it depends on the core material, the design of the machine and the type of curve fitting technique employed.
a simple polynomial of degree 3 is the best approach to curve fitting for magnetizing characteristics of SEIGs.
the curve-fitting techniques based on polynomial, exponential and rational approximations are more suitable than those based on hyperbolic, logarithmic and power approximations.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the curve fitting of the magnetizing characteristics of SEIGs should be done by the least squares method.
, for a particular machine design, the choice of the curve fitting method depends on the range of magnetization current and the desired accuracy of the results.
, the magnetization curve should be represented with the highest possible degree of polynomial.
